name: Plus AI
summary: AI add-on for Google Slides and PowerPoint that generates, edits and reformats presentations.
description: Plus AI works inside Google Slides and PowerPoint. It creates presentations from prompts or documents, edits and reformats existing slides with AI, applies custom branding and generates images, and it offers an API and MCP server. All paid plans start with a seven-day free trial with 1,000 AI credits. Basic costs $10 per user per month billed annually or $15 monthly.

howToUse.title: Open Plus AI
howToUse.description: Open Plus AI and sign up with Google or Microsoft. It works inside Google Slides and PowerPoint.

howToUse.title: Start from a prompt or a document
howToUse.description: Create presentations from prompts or documents. You can upload a PDF, a Word document, a PowerPoint file, or a text file.

howToUse.title: Edit, reformat, and brand the slides
howToUse.description: Plus AI edits and reformats existing slides, applies custom branding, and generates images.

howToUse.title: Start the trial if you need credits
howToUse.description: All paid plans start with a seven-day trial and 1,000 AI credits. Basic costs $10 per user per month if billed annually, or $15 monthly. It also offers an API and an MCP server.
